title: Add Codex CLI support
description: Add Codex CLI as a Staffed agent integration. Verify the current Codex agent/subagent format, canonical user and project paths, discovery mechanism, model controls, and activation behavior against a real install before enabling support. Extend agent selection and detection, rendering, lifecycle ownership, documentation, and tests. Deliver as its own reviewed commit before starting OpenCode support.

title: Add OpenCode support
description: Complete and verify the existing OpenCode integration after Codex CLI support is committed. Confirm the current agent format, canonical paths, discovery and activation behavior, model and profile constraints, and real-host lifecycle safety before enabling support. Update detection, documentation, and tests, then deliver as a separate reviewed commit.
